overview: Run a shared QwenPaw Hub with per-user runtimes, isolated workspaces, skills, channels, and local or cloud models.
description:
QwenPaw (Qwen Personal Agent Workstation) is an open-source personal AI assistant from the AgentScope team. QwenPaw Hub is its multi-user control plane: team members sign in at one address, and each person gets a separate QwenPaw with its own workspace, settings, credentials, and conversations.

This package deploys QwenPaw Hub as a single control-plane container with the Local runtime backend. The Hub console is published on port 8088 and is seeded with a package-managed administrator account. The control database and every user runtime persist in the qwenpaw_data volume, and administrators can create accounts, manage runtimes, and control registration mode.

QwenPaw supports cloud model providers (DashScope/Qwen, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, and more) as well as local models through the built-in QwenPaw Local runtime, Ollama, or LM Studio. Extend it with Skills, Plugins, and MCP tools, and automate recurring work with built-in cron scheduling.
